Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by the document ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures as an inner join on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
